selection_rule.acceptable_initial_band: 1/2 workers; 2/2 may be retained only if partial failures appear in later layers during a follow-up calibration.
selection_rule.reject_too_hard: 0/2 full-Core workers with both workers below 0.8 normalized Core.
selection_rule.reject_too_easy: 2/2 full-Core workers with low trajectory variance and no meaningful implementation pressure.
tie_breakers: No infrastructure, gateway, or benchmark-access violations
Shorter runtime and lower token cost
